Awarded on the completion of the second year to a student in Smith Engineering with a sound academic record who has demonstrated outstanding performance in extra-curricular activities on campus. Nominations are to be made by Heads of Departments by 31 March , who will then forward their nominations to Smith Engineering for selection by the Operations Committee (Scholarship).

listings.name: Science '50 Entrance Bursary
listings.summary: Established by the class of Science 1950 and awarded on the basis of financial need to a student entering the first year program in Smith Engineering. Application should be made to the Office of the University Registrar, Financial Aid, and Awards by February 15.

listings.name: Science '54 Bursary
listings.summary: Established with funds donated by the members of Science '54 and given in appreciation of the efforts of Fred Siemonsen, Science '54, and his wife Mary Lou Siemonsen. Awarded to a student in Smith Engineering in financial need.

listings.name: Science '58 Admission Bursary in Applied Science
listings.summary: Established in March 1997 by the Class of Science 1958 and last revised in June 2022. Awarded on the basis of demonstrated financial need to students entering first year of any first-entry undergraduate degree program in Smith Engineering. Applications are to be made to the Office of the University Registrar, Financial Aid and Awards by February 15. Value: variable.

listings.name: Science '59 Admission Award
listings.summary: Established in October 1999 by the alumni of the Class of Science 1959 and awarded on the basis of demonstrated financial need, academic excellence, proven leadership skills, and involvement in school or community activities to students entering the first-year program in Smith Engineering. The award is renewable for three subsequent years provided a satisfactory academic average is maintained each year, financial need remains evident, and involvement in school or community activities is sustained. Applications are to be made to the Office of the University Registrar, Financial Aid, and Awards

listings.name: Science '71 Norman Fritz Memorial Award
listings.summary: Awarded annually to a fourth year student of Smith Engineering who displays conspicuous leadership and management skill in a student-organized faculty activity, which has educational value. An example of such an activity might be that of Convener of the Science Formal. The recipient of the award is to be selected by the Dean of Smith Engineering and the presentation will be made during the first quarter of each calendar year.

listings.name: Science '89 Bursary
listings.summary: Established in April 2001 by the Class of Science '89 and awarded on the basis of financial need to an upper-year student in Smith Engineering. Application should be made to the Office of the University Registrar, Financial Aid and Awards by October 31.

listings.name: Science '95 Bursary in Applied Science
listings.summary: Established under the ThankQ program by the Class of Science '95 upon their graduation and awarded on the basis of financial need to two students in their second, third or fourth year in Smith Engineering who have been involved in some form of extra-curricular activity (i.e. athletics, part-time employment, school council, etc.).

listings.name: Science '99 Award
listings.summary: Established by the Class of Science 1999, with donations to the ThankQ '99 Class Gift Campaign. Awarded to a full-time second, third or fourth year student in Smith Engineering on the basis of financial need and involvement in extracurricular activities that could include employment with a Queen's organization.

listings.name: Science 1923 Bursary
listings.summary: Awarded to an undergraduate student in second or third year in either Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, on the basis of satisfactory academic performance, financial need and participation in a wide range of student activities.

listings.name: Science 1928 Bursary
listings.summary: Established in February 1999 by the Estate of Elizabeth Bauld in recognition of A.W. McNeil, W.S. Miller, R.H. Bissell and W.E. Wright, all Applied Science graduates of Queen's. Last revised in September 2025 and awarded on the basis of demonstrated financial need to students entering first year of any first-entry undergraduate degree program in Smith Engineering.

listings.name: Science 1941 Admission Bursary in Applied Science
listings.summary: Established in March 1997 by the Class of Science 1941 to honour members of the Class and to recognize their contributions to Smith Engineering. Last revised in September 2025 and awarded on the basis of demonstrated financial need to students entering first year of any first-entry undergraduate degree program in Smith Engineering.

listings.name: Science 1945 Memorial Bursary
listings.summary: Awarded annually to a student or students in any year of Smith Engineering on the basis of satisfactory academic performance, financial need and participation in a broad range of student activities.

listings.name: Science 1946 Memorial Bursary
listings.summary: Established in 1946 by Queen’s University and was maintained by the Class of Science 1946 as a memorial to the members who gave their lives in World War II. Last revised in July 2022. Awarded on the basis of demonstrated financial need to students in any year of a Bachelor of Applied Science degree program. Applications are to be made to the Office of the University Registrar, Financial Aid and Awards by 31 October.
